items.title: Both selfish and prosocial actors distort their impact on others, but selfish-serving spin seems to spread
items.summary: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02584-4 From consumers buying fair-trade products to policy makers funding science, people often do not know exactly how their actions will affect others.
